prompts.corr: A luxury glass corridor that is alive: warm reflections glide slowly along the glass walls, thin streaks of light travel back and forth along the top edges of the glass panels, the pendant lights breathe softly in brightness, the white hydrangeas move very slightly. The white arched panel in the centre stays perfectly blank, flat and evenly lit. The camera is completely locked off on a tripod: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, no reframing. Every wall, object and surface stays exactly where it is in the image; nothing is added or removed; no text appears anywhere. Photorealistic, natural light behaviour. Seamless loop: the last frame is identical to the first frame.
prompts.street: Night street outside the LIVING CANVAS party shop. The camera is completely locked off on a tripod: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, no reframing.
